templates.mechanic: help_1 / Story_HELP object expanded into 10 Home/Guest pairs and 10 group CL resources gated by the player's last ID digit via multiplicity
rules: Use the field shape from help_1: Home is a chest block, Guest is a furniture block with behaviour.1.chest and rand_reward fields.
Input paths use Fun11 donor files; output paths use the target prefix, for example Fun13.
Create 10 Home rows and 10 Guest rows. Group index 1..9 maps to multiplicity 1..9; group index 10 maps to multiplicity 0.
Each Home row spends its own collection reward: open_price=asset={prefix}_FunCollection_{collection_number}_CL_{index}:{home_open_amount}.
Create 10 CL assets, 10 CL packages and 10 global_reward rows with active_quest={tech_quest}+multiplicity={multiplicity}.
Do not use this template as campaign quest interactive_objects.json; it is a FunCollection potekha template derived from help_1.

templates.mechanic: Players are split into two halves by the last digit of player id. One half gets resource A, the other gets resource B. Players exchange/gift their own resource to friends, craft A+B into a mystery box, then open the mystery box for one random CL collection element.
rules: Use input donor paths from Fun11 or the closest older donor path when Fun11 donor does not exist; output paths always use the target prefix.
Group A/even gets resource A via conditions active_quest={tech_quest}+multiplicity=0,2,4,6,8.
Group B/odd gets resource B via conditions active_quest={tech_quest}+multiplicity=1,3,5,7,9.
Guest object A should request/gift resource B if Home A needs the other half's resource; Guest object B should request/gift resource A.
Recipe creates the mystery box from resource A + resource B.
The mystery box must contain 10 random CL collection rewards; exact one_of/chance internals are configured in the mystery_box donor/proto and represented by the 10 CL rows in this template.

templates.mechanic: Potekha/Skazaniya friend action collection object. A player performs a friend_action at a friend's home with a daily limit and success probability. The acting player receives FA_1, the home owner receives FA_2, then FA_1+FA_2 are crafted into a mystery box that gives one random CL collection element.
rules: Use this template when the user explicitly gives exact object id FunCollection_9.
This is a Potekha/Skazaniya FunCollection object, not a quest interactive object from data/interactive_object_templates.json.
The friend_action output classname is {prefix}_FunCollection_9; the availability flag is {prefix}_FunCollection_9_Available.
viewer_conditions and friend_conditions default to stuff={prefix}_FunCollection_9_Available+time<{action_end_time}.
bot_conditions default to time>{action_start_time}+time<{action_end_time}.
reward_for_action gives {prefix}_FunCollection_9_FA_1 to the acting player; reward_on_receive gives {prefix}_FunCollection_9_FA_2 to the home owner.

The recipe combines FA_1 and FA_2 into the mystery box; keep recipe reward and mystery_box classname consistent with the current proto requirements and do not leave mixed Fun12/Fun13 prefixes from the donor.
The craft station Home object points to the recipe in extra.window_spec.charging_recipe.
The mystery box contains 10 random CL rewards; represent them with collection_rewards[1..10].
All output/classname/file_name/identifier/reward/ingredients/pack_asset/view_classname values use the target prefix.
